_comment: Epoxy — Hermes Agent Free-Tier Proxy. Pools multiple Groq + Ollama Cloud API keys behind a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint with automatic rotation and cooldown handling.
name: Epoxy
author: epoxy@users.noreply.github.com
description:
Epoxy pools multiple free-tier Groq and Ollama Cloud API keys behind a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint with automatic rotation and cooldown handling. Point Hermes Agent at it via custom_providers.

Configure API keys via the Startup tab (egg variables below) OR edit /home/container/.env through the File Manager — whichever method you prefer. OS env vars (egg variables) take precedence.

Hermes config.yaml:
  custom_providers:
    free-pool:
      base_url: http://<server-ip>:{{SERVER_PORT}}

Then use /model <model-name> in Hermes.

Models:
  - groq-llama-3.1-8b-instant  (or any Groq model)
  - ollama-deepseek-v3.1       (or any Ollama model)

Pool strategies (GROQ_POOL_STRATEGY / OLLAMA_POOL_STRATEGY):
  fill_first  — drain first healthy key before moving on
  round_robin — cycle evenly across all healthy keys (default)
  least_used  — pick the key with fewest requests
  random      — random selection among healthy keys

Cooldowns:
  429 (rate limited)  → 1h cooldown on that key
  402 (billing)       → 24h cooldown
  401 (auth error)    → immediate rotation

installation.script:
echo "Epoxy — all dependencies are baked into the image."
echo "Set GROQ_API_KEYS and OLLAMA_API_KEYS in the Startup tab,"
echo "or edit /home/container/.env via the File Manager."
echo "After changing keys, restart the container."

variables.name: Groq API Keys
variables.description: Comma-separated Groq API keys. Leave empty to use /home/container/.env via File Manager instead.

variables.name: Ollama Cloud API Keys
variables.description: Comma-separated Ollama Cloud API keys. Leave empty to use /home/container/.env via File Manager instead.

variables.name: Groq Pool Strategy
variables.description: Key selection strategy: fill_first, round_robin, least_used, random.

variables.name: Ollama Pool Strategy
variables.description: Key selection strategy: fill_first, round_robin, least_used, random.

variables.name: Server Port
variables.description: Internal port (Pterodactyl allocation will map to this).
